Examples
Used for actions that were completed at a specific time in the past
Positive: Subject + verb in past tense
Negative: Subject + did not + verb in base form
Question: Did + subject + verb in base form?
I played videogames after school. (positive)
He did not go to work yesterday. (negative)
Did you see that basketball game yesterday? (question)

Past
Continuous
Use
Form
Examples
Used for actions that were ongoing at a specific time in the past
Positive: Subject + was/were + verb ending in “ing”
Negative: Subject + was/were not + verb ending in “ing”
Question: Was/were + subject + verb ending in “ing”?
I was sleeping when the alarm went off. (positive)
He was not cleaning when his mom came home. (negative)
Were you traveling in Europe last year? (question)
